plan.hypothesis: Cache reference second moment E[y²], derive variance beside prediction statistics instead of caching the variance. Test whether this reduces mismatch with the uncached SSIM path; this is not a proven cause of the earlier pipes regression.
plan.scope: One optional experimental engine path; production unchanged. Compare maps and gradients using real photographs and frozen predictions, then eight short 1000-step paired photo reconstructions with early state snapshots. Stop without long retraining if no consistent numerical or short-run evidence.
plan.comparison: Both variants cache reference statistics; baseline stores variance, candidate stores raw second moment. Uncached formula is the separate component numerical reference.
plan.acceptance: Numerical tests/fallbacks must pass. Require a consistent reduction of photo-map/gradient mismatch before costly default-quality retraining; short runs alone cannot establish quality improvement.
plan.timing_scope: Short reconstruction timing includes early state readbacks and reference tracing; no speed claim, no fresh SfM or API end-to-end measurement.

diagnostic_followup.reason: Uncached repeat also differed on 626x469 TUM input; maximum discrepancy lies near the lower/right image boundary. Added a controlled component-only two-column zero padding probe.
diagnostic_followup.component_alignment: 628x469; not used for training, not a camera calibration change
diagnostic_followup.long_training_decision: Defer: original 626x469 component repeatability issue unresolved. Proceed only with preplanned two-scene short runs at 512.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, including early state readbacks and per-process first reference-statistics cache population; no speed claim. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
memory_scope: Logical cached reference mean/variance tensor storage only; not allocator capacity or peak process/GPU memory.

references.title: SSIM: Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity
references.use: Local reference variance is E[y²] minus squared mean; caching changes where the subtraction is evaluated.

references.title: fused-ssim Metal implementation
references.use: Forms variance from local first and second moments alongside final SSIM evaluation. Only informs the hypothesis; no kernels copied.

references.title: Faster-GS: Analyzing and Improving Gaussian Splatting Optimization
references.latest_change: 2026-10-10: absolute-gradient densification using GOF selection. Not ported or benchmarked in this study.
references.use: Keep numerical/implementation diagnostics separate from algorithm changes; this local study remains Burn/Wgpu/Metal, not the CUDA backend.

initial.scope: Numerical diagnostic relative to uncached formula, not a performance benchmark or proof of correctness for all images.

repeat_control.scope: Numerical diagnostic relative to uncached formula, not a performance benchmark or proof of correctness for all images.

alignment_control.scope: Numerical diagnostic relative to uncached formula, not a performance benchmark or proof of correctness for all images.

validation.real_photo_probe: Diagnostic completed; five scene/size pairs match exactly in the moment variant, unaligned TUM fails repeatability including uncached control. Not an all-case accuracy pass.

browser.observations: Short 1000-step models remain blurred; fine structures and text are missing, stretched or floating fragments remain outside captured views.

raw_metric_scope: raw_runs evaluation/summary are native Brush metrics. summary/aligned_comparisons use common long-edge 512 RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM.
decision: Keep second-moment caching as an experimental path; do not enable by default. No long default-quality run while the 626x469 component repeatability anomaly remains unresolved. Improve isolated dimension/tail tests before attempting a production fix; do not pad training images or alter calibration based only on this diagnostic.
